slice: Rewrite the Homepage promise so an ordinary person immediately understands Werkles as democratic business help, not a proof/compliance gate. Review and copy proposals only.
sharedContext: Operator correction: human readers have immediate negative reactions to the word proof on the Homepage.
Current headline: Find the people and proof that move your business forward.
Current subhead: Werkles helps builders name what they need, find reachable help, and verify the facts before they rely on anyone.
Current positioning: For real operators, builders, connectors, and backers who need momentum without guessing who to trust.
Current CTA: Let us help you discover what you need.

Werkles should help a person understand what they are trying to make real, discover possible paths, find practical people/resources/services/knowledge/opportunities, compare them honestly, and take a useful next step.
Proof/verification is one contextual support function. It must not define the entire front-door promise.
Ben's 76-year-old-mother test: nobody should feel they must already be from a business/startup world to understand or belong.
liveStrings: Find the people and proof that move your business forward.
Werkles helps builders name what they need, find reachable help, and verify the facts before they rely on anyone.
For real operators, builders, connectors, and backers who need momentum without guessing who to trust.
Real human help, with proof shown before you rely on it.
knownGaps: The current product cannot honestly promise that every recommendation executes, introduces, purchases, funds, or completes work.
The matching and recommendation system remains under repair; copy cannot outrun functionality.
This assignment does not authorize a Homepage redesign or implementation.

ENDER.vision: Make the first ten seconds feel welcoming, human, useful, and emotionally alive to someone who does not speak startup or trust-system language.
ENDER.pull: Attack every live line for proof fixation, gatekeeping, insider identity, abstraction, stiffness, and whether it sounds like a compliance product rather than practical help.
go: Return one recommended headline/subhead/positioning/CTA set in plain language.
Apply Ben's-mother test and explain the single strongest reason the existing promise excludes ordinary people.
Give a five-line homepage copy-pruning rule that can be reused across the site.
ENDER.momentum: End with PASS_TO_IMPLEMENT or REWRITE_AGAIN and one live human read-aloud test.
ENDER.outOfLane: No code, page redesign, provider/legal claims, secrets, SQL, push/deploy, new task, subagents, or secondary models.

SKYBRO.vision: Recover the large democratic Werkles promise without drifting into universal-assistant fantasy or vague inspiration copy.
SKYBRO.pull: Challenge the product thesis: what Werkles democratizes, what concrete transformation it promises, and how trust/proof should support rather than dominate that story.
go: Return one strategic promise sentence and three concrete supporting outcomes an ordinary person can recognize.
Rewrite the headline/subhead so the promise includes paths, people, resources, knowledge, and action without becoming a list.
Name the one thing the Homepage must not promise until the current product can actually deliver it.
SKYBRO.momentum: End with PASS_TO_IMPLEMENT or REWRITE_AGAIN and the smallest differentiated Werkles thesis.
SKYBRO.outOfLane: No code, page redesign, provider/legal claims, secrets, SQL, push/deploy, new task, subagents, or secondary models.
